description: Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (TASE) end-of-day data, 30 securities per page in TASE's order: security ID, ISIN, symbol, name, type (share, bond, warrant, ETF...), last price, % change, base/open/high/low, deals, turnover (ILS thousands), units, market value, monthly and annual yield, bond details (redemption, linkage, coupon) where relevant, trade date and total count.
